description: This file defines classes, enums, and functions related to web request handling, including request serialization/deserialization, MIME types, encoding, signatures, and authorization within the Thunder Web namespace.

classes.name: Web::Signature
classes.description: Represents a cryptographic signature with hash type and value, supporting comparison and data access.

classes.name: Web::Authorization
classes.description: Handles authorization data with type and token, supporting comparison and data access.

classes.name: Web::Request
classes.description: Encapsulates an HTTP/WebSocket request with serialization/deserialization, headers, body, and related properties.

classes.name: Web::Request::Serializer
classes.description: Abstract class for serializing Web::Request objects into byte streams.

classes.name: Web::Request::Deserializer
classes.description: Abstract class for deserializing byte streams into Web::Request objects.

classes.name: Web::IBody
classes.description: Interface for request/response body serialization and deserialization.

methods.name: MIMETypeAndEncodingForFile
methods.description: Determines MIME type and encoding for a given file path.

methods.name: Signature::operator==
methods.description: Checks equality between two Signature objects.

methods.name: Signature::operator!=
methods.description: Checks inequality between two Signature objects.

methods.name: Authorization::operator==
methods.description: Checks equality between two Authorization objects.

methods.name: Authorization::operator!=
methods.description: Checks inequality between two Authorization objects.

methods.name: Request::ToString
methods.description: Serializes a Web::Request object into a string.

methods.name: Request::FromString
methods.description: Deserializes a string into a Web::Request object.

methods.name: Request::IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the request has a valid verb.

methods.name: Request::Clear
methods.description: Resets the request object to default state.

methods.name: Request::ScanForKeyword
methods.description: Checks if a keyword exists in a buffer string.
